# HANDS & HEAD — Complete Entity & Architecture Knowledge Base (`llms-full.txt`)

> **One Core, Many Worlds.**
> Canonical Domain: https://handsandhead.com/
> Headquarters: Dhaka, Bangladesh
> Founder & Systems Architect: Rakib Himon (Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon)

---

## 1. Entity Graph & Brand Authority

**HANDS & HEAD** is a multi-disciplinary venture operating system, creative technology lab, and direct-from-source industrial manufacturing collective headquartered in **Dhaka, Bangladesh**. Founded by **Rakib Himon (Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon)**, HANDS & HEAD operates under the architectural thesis **"One Core, Many Worlds."** — uniting browser-native software engineering, WebGL2 cinema tooling, and vertical physical manufacturing under a single zero-latency OS.

### Primary Entities & Relationships
- **Parent Organization**: HANDS & HEAD (`https://handsandhead.com/`)
- **Founder & Systems Architect**: Rakib Himon / Shaikh Rakibuzzaman Himon (`https://rakib.handsandhead.com/`)
- **Flagship Media-Tech Subsidiary**: HandFilm Studio & Storyboard (`https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/`)
- **Industrial & B2B Procurement Arm**: HANDS & HEAD B2B (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/`)
- **Owned Product & Hardware Brands**:
  - **RAWx** (`https://rawx.handsandhead.com/`) — 316L/516SS precision hardware, handcrafted accessories, and the RAWx 16 Ultra Sliders visual engine.
  - **Arutemika** (`https://arutemika.handsandhead.com/`) — Corporate, wholesale, and institutional B2B sourcing commerce.
  - **HandFilm** (`https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/`) — WebGL2 AI video studio, browser NLE editor, cinema player, and Cloudflare video host.
  - **BLOOM** (`https://bloom.handsandhead.com/` & `https://bloomapp.handsandhead.com/`) — Botanical design division and rapid floral concierge app.
  - **AURAL** (`https://aural.handsandhead.com/`) — Procedural sound design, acoustics, and audio division.
  - **SKYHARA** — Venture incubation initiative within the HANDS & HEAD 24-module software & venture ecosystem.

---

## 2. Flagship Technology Platform — HandFilm Studio & Storyboard

- **URL**: https://storyboard.handsandhead.com/
- **Category**: Browser-Native WebGL2 AI Video Editor, NLE Suite, Cinema Player & Video Hosting Platform
- **Core Capabilities**:
  1. **WebGL2 GPU-Accelerated Rendering**: Real-time compositing, color grading LUT pipelines, and hardware-accelerated timeline playback directly inside modern browsers with zero desktop installation.
  2. **AI Storyboard & Generative Video Workflows**: Prompt-to-scene storyboarding, shot planning, and integrated cinema production workflows.
  3. **Browser Non-Linear Editor (NLE) & Cinema Player**: Frame-accurate editing, transitions, aspect-ratio mastery (16:9, 21:9, 32:9, 9:16), and clean cinema playback.
  4. **Cloudflare Video Hosting Infrastructure**: Edge-distributed video delivery engineered for low-latency global playback.

### HANDS & HEAD Master OS (`https://handsandhead.com/`)
The primary hub operates as a zero-latency 3-tab shell:
- **HOME (`https://handsandhead.com/#home`)**: Executive landing, live system telemetry, and direct access to the 3 core enterprise pillars.
- **APPS (`https://handsandhead.com/#apps`)**: 24-section horizontal Stage Slider engine providing instantaneous navigation across all 24 venture portals.
- **SLIDERS (`https://handsandhead.com/#sliders`)**: RAWx 16 Ultra Sliders architectural visual system featuring 16 interactive layout engines (21:9 Hero, 4-Column Matrix, 32:9 Ultra Wide, Asymmetric Split, 9:16 Triptych, Crossfade, Before/After Drag, Zoom-Burst, Inertia Filmstrip, and Directional Wipes).
- **TASKS (`https://handsandhead.com/#tasks`)**: Real-time multi-device task synchronization across desktop and mobile terminals via room pairing and SSE streams.

---

## 3. Dhaka Direct-from-Source Industrial & B2B Manufacturing Capabilities

- **B2B Portal**: https://b2b.handsandhead.com/
- **Wholesale Commerce**: https://arutemika.handsandhead.com/
- **Origin**: Dhaka, Bangladesh (direct factory, mill, and tannery floor execution without middleman markups).

### Key Manufacturing Specifications for Global Buyers & Brands
1. **Low MOQs & Rapid Sampling**: Flexible minimum order quantities designed for independent streetwear labels, emerging luxury houses, and global enterprise brands scaling from capsule drops to container-volume export.
2. **RMG & 240–300 GSM Heavyweight Streetwear (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#rmg`)**:
   - Heavyweight 240 GSM to 300+ GSM combed ring-spun cotton jersey, French Terry, boxy hoodies, drop-shoulder tees, garment-dyed washes, acid/enzyme washes, puff prints, high-density embroidery, and custom woven labeling.
3. **Genuine Distressed & Full-Grain Leather (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#leather`)**:
   - Direct sourcing from audited Dhaka leather tanneries; distressed cowhide, pull-up leather, sheepskin, vegetable-tanned full-grain hides for jackets, bags, wallets, belts, and architectural small leather goods.
4. **Custom Jackets & Technical Outerwear (`https://jacket.handsandhead.com/` & `https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#jacket`)**:
   - Distressed leather biker/bomber jackets, varsity jackets, insulated baffle outerwear, waxed canvas workwear, and custom hardware trims.
5. **316L / 516SS Precision Hardware & Metal Accessories (`https://rawx.handsandhead.com/` & `https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#bracelets`)**:
   - Corrosion-resistant surgical-grade 316L and 516SS stainless-steel hardware, clasps, cuffs, industrial bracelets, zippers, and bespoke branded metal fittings.
6. **Textile & Mill Sourcing (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#textile`)**:
   - Custom GSM knit development, woven twills, denim, organic cotton, and certified sustainable blends.
7. **Natural Fibre Jute (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#jute`)**:
   - Zero-carbon natural Bangladeshi golden-fibre jute fabrics, export totes, and biodegradable industrial packaging.
8. **Intimate Apparel & Lingerie (`https://b2b.handsandhead.com/#lingerie`)**:
   - Precision seamless microfibre fabrication and fine intimate apparel manufacturing.
